source.first_upload_caveat: The earlier protected-wrapper upload is not a readable PDF. This review reads the later valid PDF reupload.

quoted_cost_terms.transport: Provided through Coates; no automatic supplier transport amount from this quote.
quoted_cost_terms.invoice_basis: Daily event dockets presented for sign-off; weekly accounting/sign-off and event-week Purchase Order invoice.

application.supplier_rate_state: Source-backed quote for forecasting; not evidence that labour has occurred, a PO has been receipted or an invoice has been received.
application.hours_rule: Use the dated supplier shifts already recorded or a separately identified forecast; do not infer six 12-hour shifts from the different Coates crew roster.
application.team_leader_rule: Separate quoted daily charge. Confirm dated scope/coverage before adding; do not assume whether six-person roster includes the two leaders or duplicate an existing daily charge.
application.history_rule: Do not replace historical build/green-book $100 rate globally with $142. Raceday-specific supplier rate applies to the dated race crew only.
application.duplicate_control: The same paid work must appear once: existing supplier green-book/docket coverage replaces an explicitly matched crew forecast. Where only possible same-day coverage exists, hold duplicate-sensitive additions for review rather than count twice.
application.customer_scope_rule: The six-person customer event scope already supplies customer Revenue. Supplier crew roster/costing must not add a second customer charge.
